scope: bounded development comparison, then gate before new holdout
development: same two registered Marshmallow dev instances, one attempt each per arm
causal_scope: compare mode with recommended sampling as a package; not isolated thinking effect
capture: off in development; full original capture in post-selection acceptance, separately costed
history: final answers and tool observations only; reasoning kept in raw inference records; no truncation
recovery: review every four turns and after three unchanged actions; no task-specific solution injection
selection: require 2/2 official dev resolved, preserved existing tests and no infrastructure failures; rank passing arms by resolved then generation tokens then fixed nonthinking tie break
holdout: if development gate passes, freeze all actor/evaluator files, deterministically register two unused test IDs by identity-only SHA256 order; exclude all four used instances; access bodies after freeze only; gold never read, hidden tests evaluator only
failure: if neither arm passes do not run new holdout; diagnose dev and report unmet gate, never promote by lowering criteria
